entreprise.inactive: This campaign is no longer active.
entreprise.hero_description: {company} is joining the donor brigade in 2026. Assess your agent profile and accept the mission.
entreprise.faq_section_subtitle: Before accepting the mission, let's clear up a few mysteries. Click on the cards to discover what lies behind each donation.
entreprise.cta_section_line3: A mission that could save three lives.
entreprise.cta_section_description: Your agent profile awaits. No obligation, no commitment: just a quiz to find out if you're eligible. The blood of every member of the {company} brigade counts.
entreprise.faq_0_a: Every day, Geneva hospitals need hundreds of donations to treat their patients. No donors, no transfusions. No transfusions, no second chance. Your commitment is their only hope.
entreprise.faq_1_a: The collection takes less than 10 minutes. Including welcome, medical questionnaire and refreshments, allow about 45 minutes. Think of it as a slightly longer coffee break for a slightly more important cause.
entreprise.faq_2_a: The prick lasts a second. During the collection, you feel nothing. The CTS team is trained to make the experience as comfortable as possible. Some donors almost fall asleep in the chairs.
entreprise.faq_3_a: 450 millilitres, roughly a small can. That's less than 10% of your total blood volume and your body replenishes it within a few weeks. You won't feel any difference.
entreprise.faq_4_q: What if I feel unwell afterwards?
entreprise.faq_4_a: The CTS team is there before, during and after. At the end of the donation, you stay under observation for 10 to 15 minutes with a snack. The vast majority of donors then get on with their day normally.
entreprise.faq_5_a: Absolutely not. Eat and drink normally. Just avoid fatty meals in the 4 hours before. A snack is provided after the donation to end your mission on a high.
entreprise.faq_6_a: A few contraindications exist: under 50 kg, certain medical treatments, recent travel to certain areas, certain temporary health conditions. Rather than guessing, take our eligibility quiz in 5 minutes.
entreprise.faq_7_a: Patients at the HUG. Your donation is split into three components: red blood cells, plasma and platelets. Each goes to a different person. An accident victim, a post-op patient, a child in treatment. Three lives for one donation.
entreprise.faq_8_a: Men can donate up to 4 times a year, women up to 3 times. A minimum gap of 3 months between donations is required. One mission leads to the next.
